assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: 全部空间图层基于临时粗略边界(PROV-SITE-001 及三处重点区矩形)生成;该边界仅由公告文字四至与面积拟合。
assumptions.impact: 官方红线与重点区多边形发布后,须重新生成 site_boundary、key_areas、land_use、roads、green_space、public_space、buildings、phasing 并重算全部指标、图面与可视化。

assumptions.statement: 建筑基底、层数与建筑规模由程序化规则估算(基底率约25%/单元,层数按建筑类型),非现状调查或控规条件。
assumptions.impact: 概念容积率与建筑规模仅供讨论;正式开发强度须以控规条件与现状调查为准。

assumptions.statement: 现状建筑、权属、市政管线与文保控制线底数缺失;保留/更新/拆除分类为方向性概念。
assumptions.impact: 拆改留结论不构成任何法定判断;须专业团队按正式底数深化。
